properties.name: A93 Cairnwell Pass
properties.reason: High mountain A-road over Glenshee. Penfold has no dimensional issue, but gradients, snow, ice and exposure justify care.

properties.name: A939 Cock Bridge–Tomintoul (Lecht)
properties.reason: Steep exposed mountain A-road with winter-weather vulnerability. Normally suitable for Penfold in settled conditions.

properties.name: B974 Cairn o' Mount
properties.reason: Steep and exposed B-road with sharp bends. Penfold is suitable, but winter conditions and visibility can change quickly.

properties.name: B862 Fort Augustus–Inverness east Loch Ness
properties.reason: Scenic east-side Loch Ness route with narrow sections and bends. More demanding than the A82 but comfortable enough for Penfold.

properties.name: B852 Loch Ness shore road
properties.reason: Narrow loch-side B-road with bends and occasional constrained passing. Fine for Penfold if driven patiently.

properties.name: B8074 Glen Orchy
properties.reason: Long scenic glen road with narrow and single-track-feeling sections. Penfold fits; passing and wildlife are the main considerations.

properties.name: A85 Crianlarich–Oban
properties.reason: Main strategic west-coast route carrying coaches and commercial traffic. Default green for Penfold.

properties.name: A828 Oban–Ballachulish
properties.reason: Main coastal A-road with good suitability for campervans. Default green for Penfold.

properties.name: A890 Kyle–Achnasheen
properties.reason: Primary route across Wester Ross and a sensible Penfold corridor, despite remote scenery and occasional narrower sections.

properties.name: A835 Ullapool–Ledmore
properties.reason: Main strategic route north from Ullapool, markedly easier than many coastal alternatives. Default green for Penfold.

properties.name: B4518 Elan Valley–Llanidloes
properties.reason: Scenic cross-country B-road with bends and narrower sections. Penfold is workable; progress is slower than on trunk routes.

properties.name: A4061 Rhigos Mountain Road
properties.reason: Steep and exposed mountain A-road but built for normal through traffic. Penfold is suitable with normal mountain-road care.

properties.name: A4107 Afan Valley road
properties.reason: Bendy upland A-road with gradients but normal vehicle access. Generally suitable for Penfold.

properties.name: B4560 Llangynidr–Beaufort
properties.reason: Narrow and twisty upland B-road with open moorland sections. Penfold fits but is less relaxed than the nearby main A-road network.

properties.name: A487 Fishguard–Cardigan
properties.reason: Principal west-coast A-road and the sensible campervan corridor between towns. Default green for Penfold.

properties.name: B4313 Gwaun Valley road
properties.reason: Narrow rural valley road with limited passing and tight hedge-bound sections. Penfold can fit but this is not a carefree shortcut.

properties.name: A684 Wensleydale
properties.reason: Main east-west Dales corridor, routinely used by normal commercial traffic. Default suitable for Penfold.

properties.name: B6255 Ribblehead–Hawes
properties.reason: Open moorland B-road with bends, gradients and tourist traffic. Penfold is a sensible size and should be comfortable in normal conditions.

properties.name: B6160 Wharfedale
properties.reason: Scenic valley road with narrower village sections and seasonal traffic. Suitable for Penfold with patience.

properties.name: B6270 Swaledale
properties.reason: Long scenic Dales road, narrow in places but generally suitable for Transporter-sized campers. Expect cyclists and livestock.

properties.name: A686 Hartside Pass
properties.reason: High exposed A-road with long climbs and descents. Penfold is dimensionally fine; weather and braking discipline matter.

properties.name: B6277 Alston–Middleton-in-Teesdale
properties.reason: Remote upland B-road with bends and exposed sections. Penfold is suitable, though winter conditions can be severe.

properties.name: B3135 Mendip Hills
properties.reason: Scenic Mendip B-road with bends and occasional constrained sections. Penfold should be comfortable with normal care.

properties.name: B3357 Tavistock–Princetown
properties.reason: Moorland B-road with bends, livestock and exposed sections. Generally a much better Penfold choice than tiny Dartmoor lanes.
properties.evidence: official Dartmoor motorhome guidance + road class

properties.name: B3212 Princetown–Yelverton
properties.reason: Main signed Dartmoor through-road and generally suitable for campervans. Prefer this to unsigned moorland shortcuts.
properties.evidence: official Dartmoor motorhome guidance + road class

properties.name: B3223 Simonsbath–Exford
properties.reason: Rural Exmoor B-road with bends, gradients and livestock. Suitable for Penfold, though slower than trunk routes.

properties.name: Porlock Toll Road
properties.reason: Privately managed alternative to the steep A39 Porlock Hill, commonly used as the lower-stress route for larger vehicles and campervans.

properties.name: Watersmeet road (A39 east of Lynmouth)
properties.reason: Steep wooded A-road with bends and visitor traffic. Penfold is suitable but descents need care.

properties.name: Boscastle main approach A39/B3263
properties.reason: Main signed approach is workable for Penfold, but surrounding village and coastal lanes can be substantially tighter.

properties.name: Tintagel main approach B3263
properties.reason: Main signed approach is suitable for Penfold; avoid sat-nav diversions into narrow coastal lanes around the village.

properties.name: Robin Hood's Bay visitor approach
properties.reason: Steep historic village access with very constrained lower streets. Penfold should use designated visitor parking rather than attempting the old village centre.

properties.name: Staithes visitor approach
properties.reason: Historic fishing-village streets are extremely constrained. Use the designated upper-village parking rather than driving toward the harbour.
